tests.goal: Assistant stores and retrieves a memory ad-hoc

steps.action: In a chat with a model, say "I really like it when you tell me jokes".
Go to the memory tab on the left.
acceptanceCriteria: Your memory was saved with a relevant header

steps.action: Start a new chat.
Ask "What do you know about me?"
In a chat with a model, say "I'm working on a Deloitte's internal AI tool, MyAssist. Please remember that for future discussions.".
Go to the memory tab on the left.
acceptanceCriteria: Your memory was saved with a relevant header

steps.action: Start a new chat.
Ask "What am I working on?"

tests.goal: View, edit or delete something it remembered

steps.action: Open Memory settings and find a saved memory.
Edit the memory.
Ask a query that relies on it.
acceptanceCriteria: The edited memory is used in the reply

steps.action: Delete the memory.
Ask the same query again.
acceptanceCriteria: The deleted memory is no longer accessible

steps.action: Select Memory from the side panel.
Use '+' to add a new memory.
Add inputs within the 'Create Memory' popup and click 'Create'.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is created and listed

steps.action: Ask a query that relies on it.
acceptanceCriteria: The new memory is used in the reply

tests.goal: This PR adds Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval requirements for memory mutations (set_memory and delete_memory)

steps.action: Create or select an agent that has the memory tool enabled.
Ask the agent to save a new memory (e.g. "Remember that my favourite colour is blue").
acceptanceCriteria: An approval card appears inline showing the proposed memory with Reject and Approve options
"Will be created" is shown in green

steps.action: Ask the agent to update an existing memory.
acceptanceCriteria: "Will be updated" is shown in green

steps.action: Ask the agent to delete a memory.
acceptanceCriteria: "Will be deleted" is shown in red with the trash icon

steps.action: Click the pencil icon to edit the memory.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is edited inline, not in a popup dialog

steps.action: Approve or reject each request.
acceptanceCriteria: The memory is only saved, updated or deleted when approved
